translations.web: “Yet let no man bring a charge, neither let any man accuse; for your people are like those who bring charges against a priest.
translations.bsb: But let no man contend; let no man offer reproof; for your people are like those who contend with a priest.
translations.kjv: Yet let no man strive, nor reprove another: for thy people are as they that strive with the priest.
translations.asv: Yet let no man strive, neither let any man reprove; for thy people are as they that strive with the priest.
